name: pocket-planet

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sim: SIM=1 vitest run --exclude tests/economy.sim.ts --exclude 'tests/sim/economy/*.sim.ts' --exclude tests/sim/loadout.sim.ts --exclude tests/sim/launchers.sim.ts --exclude tests/sim/curve-shadow.sim.ts
scripts.sim:shadow: SIM=1 SIM_SHADOW_GATE=1 SHADOW_RUNS=8 vitest run tests/sim/curve-shadow.sim.ts --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.sim:launchers: npm run sim:launcher-paired && npm run sim:launcher-picks && npm run sim:launcher-never-hurts && npm run sim:launcher-scene-unit && npm run sim:launcher-lock && npm run sim:launcher-reach
scripts.sim:launcher-paired: SIM=1 vitest run tests/sim/launchers.sim.ts -t 'relative-to-paired-Sling best launcher' --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.sim:launcher-scene-unit: SIM=1 vitest run tests/sim/launchers.sim.ts -t 'unit fly-vs-preview sector agreement' --disableConsoleIntercept
scripts.sim:launcher-lock: SIM=1 vitest run tests/levels.lint.sim.ts -t 'paired physical LAUNCHER-LOCK' --disableConsoleIntercept

description: Pocket Planet — fling, terraform and populate tiny worlds. iOS game built with Capacitor.
